name: Divorcing An Unbeliever
overview: Scripture upholds the sanctity and permanence of marriage, emphasizing that a man and wife are united as one flesh by God's design (Genesis 2:24; Matthew 19:6). God expresses His hatred for divorce, warning against treacherous dealings in marriage (Malachi 2:16). Jesus teaches that divorce is only permissible in the case of sexual immorality, otherwise separating and remarrying constitutes adultery (Matthew 19:9). These passages affirm that believers should strive to maintain their marriage covenant, especially when faced with the challenge of an unbelieving spouse.
